# Camp Resource: Fusion Core Recharger

Extend the life of your used fusion cores with this Fusion Core Recharger!

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__The Pitt Fusion Core Recharger__

**Produces**

Recharges Fusion Cores

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

0 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

Fusion Core Recharger

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

4 Fusion Cores

**Obtainable via**

The Pitt Recruitment Bundle (Real World Money)

Steam Store

Sony Store

XBOX Store

**Produces X amount per**

1 minute = 1% charge

1 hour 40 mins = 100% charge

All 4 Fusion cores charge at the same time.

**Lockable**

No

This item utilizes your stash box to sort the cores during recharging, ensuring that no other player can access them.

**Power Required**

20 power

**Flamingo Units**

1 Flamingo Unit
